guardrails: Image-derived labels are educational references, not validated trading signals.
Never score a setup from a candlestick name alone; require market context, location, confirmation, invalidation and risk.
Do not infer institutional intent from a volume-profile shape or open interest alone.
Do not claim a volume-profile metric is available unless the data adapter actually computes it from volume-at-price.
No image-derived rule may trigger an order.

modules.title: Price-action structures
bullish_context: confirmed break above resistance or neckline
invalidation below structure or retest swing
bearish_context: confirmed break below support or neckline
invalidation above structure or retest swing
modules.invalidation: A close back inside the broken structure, or a violation of the defining swing that formed the pattern.
modules.caution: Pattern names are subjective; require objective pivots and minimum structure quality.

modules.title: Candlestick patterns
bullish_context: bullish reversal pattern at a pre-marked support or after a downside sweep
subsequent candle confirms by taking pattern high or reclaiming level
bearish_context: bearish reversal pattern at a pre-marked resistance or after an upside sweep
subsequent candle confirms by taking pattern low or rejecting level
modules.invalidation: Beyond the pattern extreme, with a buffer derived from instrument volatility.
modules.caution: The chart is a visual cheat sheet; candle patterns have no standalone star rating or guaranteed outcome.

modules.title: Volume profile
candidate_uses: POC as a high-volume reference that price may revisit, not a guaranteed magnet
Acceptance outside value area may support continuation only after a confirmed close and hold
LVN may be a low-acceptance region where price can traverse quickly; verify with actual volume-at-price
HVN may behave as an acceptance or balance area
modules.invalidation: A failed acceptance/rejection read: price re-enters value and holds, or the expected level is invalidated by subsequent auction behavior.
modules.caution: 70% value area is a common convention, not universal. Session and composite profiles are not interchangeable. OHLCV candles alone cannot reconstruct true volume-at-price.

modules.title: Order-flow and footprint
candidate_uses: Use footprint evidence as confirmation at a pre-defined price location
Look for failed continuation / absorption only when the underlying bid-ask prints are available
Keep exchange-specific flow separate from candle-derived proxies
modules.invalidation: The suspected absorption or imbalance is contradicted by subsequent traded volume and price acceptance.
modules.caution: A static screenshot cannot establish live delta, aggressor classification, or institutional positioning.

workflow: Define higher-timeframe regime and key levels.
Identify a price-action structure at a pre-defined location.
Check candle confirmation; do not act on an unconfirmed pattern.
Use volume profile only when real volume-at-price data exists.
Use footprint/order-flow only when verified trade-side data exists.
Define entry trigger, stop/invalidation, target and position risk before grading.
Record the setup as a hypothesis until out-of-sample testing meets the project's evidence gate.
